metadata.description: Autonomous issue-to-PR agent runs, distributed as a single installable plugin.

plugins.name: bottega
plugins.description: /bottega:maestro is the whole pipeline: the orchestrator explores and settles the unknowns with the user, agrees a spec and commits it to the repo, puts costly decisions to a panel, builds with worker agents, has the integrated diff reviewed by both Claude and GPT, and lands a merged PR with QA evidence. The user takes part in two places, discovery and the spec agreement, and skips the spec wait by saying to run autonomously. /bottega:spec stops at an agreed repo spec committed on a work branch a later run continues, and code-review, improve, panel, and setup are available on their own.
